status_note: Dictionary, IDs and positions below are the legacy audit's tentative values (floodshift- backend/calibration/board.py). They have NOT been measured on the current physical board. Run `python -m perception.service --calibrate` with the real camera over the real board: it lists every marker ID actually detected, auto-solves per-marker rotation, and writes a verified registration with measured reprojection error. Until then, the service reports registration_verified=false in its status.

aruco.marker_size_note: null = physical marker edge length not yet measured; the solver then uses marker centres only and needs all four markers. Measure the printed black square edge in mm and set it to enable corner-based registration (16 points, partial occlusion tolerant).
